name: Zenarmor (OPNsense) Detection Suite
summary: Decoder and severity-graded rules for Zenarmor NGFW events forwarded from OPNsense: one alert per block, quiet DNS lookups raised by their pattern (beaconing, DGA), DNS resolvers and mail filters recognised without a site list, out-of-band callback domains, and normalised fields for other packs.
summary_zh: OPNsense 上 Zenarmor NGFW 事件的解碼器與分級規則：每次阻擋只告警一次，DNS 查詢靜默記錄、依行為模式（beacon、DGA）提出，不需站台清單即可認出 DNS 解析器與郵件過濾器，涵蓋頻外回呼網域，並提供可供其他套件使用的標準化欄位。
author: Jason Tools
notes: OPNsense must forward Zenarmor's reporting data to the Wazuh manager by syslog, with the program name zenarmor, and the stream must include Alerts as well as Connections and DNS. The alert record is the one record per block that carries Zenarmor's decision and the name it matched.

Grading: an unblocked malicious connection is the most serious case (130801, level 12), because the session was established. A blocked connection is graded per event: malware 130802 (level 7), command-and-control 130820 (level 10), phishing and fraud 130804 (level 5). Weak categories (Proxy, VPN, Parked Domains) stay at level 5 or below, and at level 3 when the policy blocked them (130828).

One block arrives as several records: a DNS block as a dns record, a conn record of the UDP flow and an alert record; a web block as conn, tls and alert. Each block is reported once, from its alert record; the others are recorded at level 2 (130815 for malware, 130829 for phishing), and a lookup's dns record is also counted (below). Measured over 7 days: 1,854 alert records against 3,627 conn and dns records for the same blocks.

A blocked lookup (port 53) never alerts by itself. Its alert record is recorded at level 2 (130816, 130817); its dns record, which carries the query type and the Recursion Desired bit, is classified and counted. Client-style lookups count towards beaconing, 15 lookups of one name in 15 minutes (130832, level 10), and towards 20 different threat names in 15 minutes, together with blocked connections (130833, level 10). A command-and-control name looked up by a client alerts at once (130819, level 6). This needs the DNS stream.

Internal DNS resolvers and mail filters look names up for other hosts, so the firewall sees them, not the client. Version 1.5 recognises them without a site list. A dns record with Recursion Desired = 0 (an iterative query, which a client never sends) or of type PTR, NS or SOA is resolver style on its own (130842, 130843, 130837, 130838). A client-style record (RD=1, A and the like) from a source that sent a resolver-style record within the last 15 minutes is a forwarded lookup (130844, 130847, 130848). Resolver lookups are counted only by 130834 (40 lookups of one name in 15 minutes, level 6) and 130835 (40 different names, level 7); the resolver's own query log names the client. Measured over 7.5 days on the tuned site: 1,584 of 1,811 blocked dns records were resolver style on their own; of the other 227 (a domain controller forwarding A lookups), 149 had evidence before them and 76 arrived in the same second as their evidence but just before it. The peak that a resolver contributed to 130832 in any 15 minutes fell from 12 lookups to 2.

etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-resolvers is optional tuning. It is needed only for a forwarding DNS server that relays clients' A lookups and never sends an iterative or a PTR, NS or SOA query itself: from the firewall such a server looks exactly like a client using a public resolver. Its lookups then go to 130818 and 130849 and are counted like a recognised resolver's.

Correlation memory: analysisd keeps correlation history only for the last memory_size events that matched a rule of level 1 or more (memory_size in the global section of ossec.conf, default 8192). Older events are freed and no longer count for any frequency or if_matched rule, whatever its timeframe. At about 75 events a second that is 15 to 20 minutes, on a busier manager less. Every timeframe in this pack is therefore 900 seconds or less and the thresholds are per 15 minutes. A beacon slower than about one lookup a minute, or resolver evidence older than the memory reaches, is not seen; raising memory_size widens the window at the cost of manager memory.

Out-of-band testing domains (interactsh, Burp Collaborator, canarytokens and similar) alert at level 10 whether or not the lookup came through a resolver (130840, 130841): a unique name of that kind is looked up only when some host processed an injected payload or opened a canary. Measured: a mail gateway resolved one interactsh name 13 times in four minutes.

Two Proxy-category sources are recorded at level 2 instead of alerting: Apple iCloud Private Relay (130825; 629 of 978 evasion alerts in 7 days) and check.torproject.org, the Tor exit list that threat-intelligence tools download every hour (130826; 349). A site that forbids Private Relay should block mask.icloud.com and mask-h2.icloud.com in DNS. Other site-specific names go in etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-domain-allow, which applies to the weak categories only and never to malware or phishing.

Version 1.4 fixes an overlap: the tag Botnet DGA Domains matched both the malware family (Botnet) and the phishing family (DGA), and which rule won depended on evaluation order. The phishing, evasion and parked families now exclude events that carry a tag from a more serious family, by a pcre2 lookahead rather than negate.

The decoder adds srcip, srcport, dstip, dstport and protocol, and three fields that are the same for every record type: zenarmor.index (conn, dns, tls, http, sip, alert), zenarmor.domain (the matched name for alert records, the query for dns records, the destination name otherwise) and zenarmor.category. Other packs and CDB lists can use them. Note that srcip is always the internal client: a level-based active response configured on the manager would now see it, so exclude the zenarmor group from such a response.

Parked Domains is recorded at level 0 and never alerts. The classifier appears to key on the apex having no A record, which also describes any CDN-fronted application backend, so its false-positive rate is very high. Real DGA activity is covered by 130833 instead.

Not covered: the syslog stream carries reporting records only, so Zenarmor engine errors, cloud and licence messages, policy changes and TLS-inspection failures are not in it. Generic web-filtering blocks (Ads, Social and other non-security categories) reach rule 130800 at level 0 by design. The pack ships no active response: every source address here is an internal client, and Zenarmor already blocks what it can; see the setup guide.

Verified on Wazuh 4.14.7: the <prematch>zenarmor</prematch> decoder from the vendor guide does not match; this pack uses <program_name>zenarmor</program_name>. Sibling rules under one parent are evaluated in an unpredictable order, so every sibling set in this pack is mutually exclusive, and short tokens are anchored with \b (otherwise Tor matches Torrent).
notes_zh: OPNsense 必須把 Zenarmor 的報表資料以 syslog 轉送到 Wazuh 管理端，程式名稱為 zenarmor，而且串流除了 Connections 與 DNS 之外必須包含 Alerts。每次阻擋只有 alert 記錄會帶 Zenarmor 的判定結果與比對到的名稱。
分級原則：未被阻擋的惡意連線最嚴重（130801，level 12），因為連線已經成立。已阻擋的連線逐筆分級：惡意程式 130802（level 7）、C2 130820（level 10）、釣魚與詐騙 130804（level 5）。弱訊號分類（Proxy、VPN、Parked Domains）一律 level 5 以下，被政策阻擋時為 level 3（130828）。

一次阻擋會產生好幾筆記錄：DNS 阻擋是 dns、UDP 流量的 conn 與 alert 各一筆；網頁阻擋是 conn、tls 與 alert。每次阻擋只依 alert 記錄回報一次，其餘記錄以 level 2 記下（惡意程式 130815、釣魚 130829），名稱查詢的 dns 記錄另外用來計數（見下）。7 天實測：同一批阻擋有 1,854 筆 alert 記錄，對上 3,627 筆 conn 與 dns 記錄。

被阻擋的名稱查詢（port 53）本身不告警。它的 alert 記錄以 level 2 記下（130816、130817）；它的 dns 記錄帶有查詢類型與 Recursion Desired 位元，用來分類與計數。用戶端式的查詢計入 beacon：15 分鐘內同一名稱 15 次（130832，level 10），也與被阻擋的連線一起計入 15 分鐘內 20 個不同的威脅名稱（130833，level 10）。用戶端查詢 C2 名稱時立即告警（130819，level 6）。這需要 DNS 串流。

內部 DNS 解析器與郵件過濾器會替別的主機查詢名稱，防火牆看到的是它們而不是真正的用戶端。1.5 版不需站台清單就能認出它們。Recursion Desired = 0 的 dns 記錄（迭代查詢，用戶端永遠不會送出）或類型為 PTR、NS、SOA 的記錄，本身就是解析器式（130842、130843、130837、130838）。來源在最近 15 分鐘內送過解析器式記錄時，它的用戶端式記錄（RD=1，A 等）視為轉送的查詢（130844、130847、130848）。解析器的查詢只計入 130834（15 分鐘內同一名稱 40 次，level 6）與 130835（40 個不同名稱，level 7）；真正的用戶端請查該解析器自己的查詢記錄。調校所用站台 7.5 天實測：1,811 筆被阻擋的 dns 記錄中有 1,584 筆本身就是解析器式；其餘 227 筆（一台網域控制站轉送的 A 查詢）有 149 筆之前已有證據，76 筆與證據在同一秒到達、只是排在證據之前。解析器在任何 15 分鐘內對 130832 的貢獻峰值從 12 次降到 2 次。
etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-resolvers 是選用的調校。只有轉送型 DNS 伺服器才需要它：它轉送用戶端的 A 查詢、自己從不送出迭代查詢或 PTR、NS、SOA 查詢，從防火牆看起來與使用公共解析器的用戶端完全一樣。列入後其查詢改由 130818 與 130849 記錄，並與被認出的解析器一樣計數。

關聯記憶：analysisd 只保留最近 memory_size 筆命中 level 1 以上規則的事件作為關聯歷史（ossec.conf global 區段的 memory_size，預設 8192）。更舊的事件會被釋放，不論規則的 timeframe 多長，都不再計入任何頻率或 if_matched 規則。每秒約 75 筆事件時大約是 15 到 20 分鐘，負載更高的管理端更短。因此本套件所有 timeframe 都是 900 秒以下，門檻以每 15 分鐘計。慢於約每分鐘一次的 beacon、或比記憶範圍更舊的解析器證據都看不到；調高 memory_size 可以加大範圍，代價是管理端記憶體。
頻外測試網域（interactsh、Burp Collaborator、canarytokens 等）不論是否經由解析器查詢，一律 level 10（130840、130841）：這類唯一名稱只有在某台主機處理了被注入的 payload 或開啟了 canary 時才會被查詢。實測：一台郵件閘道在四分鐘內對同一個 interactsh 名稱查了 13 次。

兩種 Proxy 分類來源改以 level 2 記錄、不告警：Apple iCloud 私密轉送（130825；7 天內 978 筆規避類告警中佔 629 筆），以及 check.torproject.org，也就是威脅情資工具每小時下載的 Tor 出口節點清單（130826；349 筆）。禁止私密轉送的站台應在 DNS 封鎖 mask.icloud.com 與 mask-h2.icloud.com。其他站台特有的名稱請加入 etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-domain-allow；此清單只作用於弱訊號分類，永遠不會讓惡意程式或釣魚告警靜音。
1.4 版修正一個重疊：Botnet DGA Domains 標籤同時符合惡意程式家族（Botnet）與釣魚家族（DGA），由哪條規則勝出取決於評估順序。釣魚、規避與寄放網域家族現在以 pcre2 lookahead（而非 negate）排除帶有更嚴重家族標籤的事件。

解碼器新增 srcip、srcport、dstip、dstport、protocol，以及三個對所有記錄類型意義一致的欄位：zenarmor.index（conn、dns、tls、http、sip、alert）、zenarmor.domain（alert 記錄是比對到的名稱，dns 記錄是查詢名稱，其他是目的主機名稱）與 zenarmor.category。其他套件與 CDB 清單可以直接使用。注意 srcip 一律是內部用戶端：管理端若設定了依等級觸發的主動回應，現在會看到它，請把 zenarmor 群組排除在該回應之外。
Parked Domains 為 level 0、不告警。分類器似乎以 apex 沒有 A 記錄判定，而 CDN 前置的應用程式後端正好符合，誤判率極高。真正的 DGA 行為改由 130833 涵蓋。
未涵蓋：syslog 串流只有報表記錄，Zenarmor 引擎錯誤、雲端與授權訊息、政策變更與 TLS 檢查失敗都不在其中。一般網頁過濾的阻擋（Ads、Social 等非資安分類）依設計停在 130800（level 0）。本套件不附主動回應：這裡的來源位址全是內部用戶端，而 Zenarmor 已經擋下它能擋的；說明見部署步驟。
Wazuh 4.14.7 實測：官方指南的 <prematch>zenarmor</prematch> 解碼器不會匹配，本套件改用 <program_name>zenarmor</program_name>。同一父規則的子規則評估順序不可預期，因此本套件的每一組同層規則都互斥；短詞一律加 \b 邊界（否則 Tor 會誤中 Torrent）。

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers. The rules must be on the node that receives the firewall's syslog. Installing declares the two CDB lists in ossec.conf; on a cluster, declare them on the workers as well.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。規則必須存在於接收防火牆 syslog 的那個節點。安裝時會在 ossec.conf 宣告兩份 CDB 清單；叢集環境請在 worker 也宣告。

setup.title: Stream Zenarmor's reporting data to the manager by syslog
setup.title_zh: 把 Zenarmor 報表資料以 syslog 串流到管理端
setup.body: In OPNsense open Zenarmor, Configuration, Data Management (called Reporting & Data in some versions), and enable streaming to a remote syslog server: the Wazuh manager's address, the port of its syslog listener, UDP or TCP. Select Connections, DNS, TLS, Web and Alerts. Alerts is required: without it every blocked threat stays at level 2. DNS is required: the dns records are what blocked lookups are counted and resolvers recognised from; without them no lookup pattern is detected. Records are about 2 KB, so over UDP they travel as IP fragments; a firewall in between must pass fragments, or use TCP. If a relay filters the stream, keep the alert records and every record with is_blocked=1 or a security tag. Nothing on the firewall restarts.
setup.body_zh: 在 OPNsense 開啟 Zenarmor → Configuration → Data Management（部分版本稱 Reporting & Data），啟用串流到遠端 syslog 伺服器：填入 Wazuh 管理端位址、其 syslog 監聽埠、UDP 或 TCP。勾選 Connections、DNS、TLS、Web 與 Alerts。Alerts 為必要：沒有它，所有被阻擋的威脅都會停在 level 2。DNS 為必要：被阻擋的查詢是依 dns 記錄計數、解析器也是依它認出；沒有它，任何查詢模式都偵測不到。每筆記錄約 2 KB，走 UDP 時會被切成 IP 分段；中間若有防火牆必須放行分段，否則請改用 TCP。若中間有轉送程式過濾串流，請保留 alert 記錄以及所有 is_blocked=1 或帶有資安標籤的記錄。防火牆上不需要重啟任何服務。
setup.verify: Browse from a test client to a site your policy blocks as Phishing or Malware. Within a minute or two the manager shows 130804 or 130802 with the blocked name; the conn and tls records of the same block are recorded as 130815 or 130829 and do not alert.
setup.verify_zh: 從測試用戶端瀏覽一個政策會以 Phishing 或 Malware 阻擋的網站。一兩分鐘內管理端應出現 130804 或 130802，並帶有被阻擋的名稱；同一次阻擋的 conn 與 tls 記錄記為 130815 或 130829、不告警。

setup.title: Accept syslog from the firewall
setup.title_zh: 接受防火牆送來的 syslog
setup.body: The manager needs a remote block for syslog that allows the firewall's address (or the relay's). Changing ossec.conf needs a manager restart; agents reconnect by themselves.
setup.body_zh: 管理端需要一個允許防火牆（或轉送程式）位址的 syslog remote 區塊。修改 ossec.conf 需要重啟管理端；agent 會自動重新連線。

setup.title: Optional: list forwarding DNS servers
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出轉送型 DNS 伺服器
setup.body: Recursive resolvers and mail filters are recognised automatically from their own DNS records. A forwarder that relays clients' A lookups and never sends an iterative or a PTR, NS or SOA query itself cannot be told apart from a client; if one trips the beaconing or many-domains rules (130832, 130833) with lookups made for its clients, list its address, one per line, then reload the ruleset. A network prefix ending in a dot (192.0.2.) also works. Its own non-DNS connections are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 遞迴解析器與郵件過濾器會從它們自己的 DNS 記錄自動認出。轉送型伺服器若只轉送用戶端的 A 查詢、自己從不送出迭代查詢或 PTR、NS、SOA 查詢，就無法與用戶端區分；若它以替用戶端做的查詢觸發 beacon 或多網域規則（130832、130833），請把它的位址列入，每個一行，加入後重新載入規則集。也可以寫以點號結尾的網段前綴（192.0.2.）。它自己的非 DNS 連線不受影響。
setup.verify: The next blocked lookups from a listed address are recorded as 130818 or 130849 instead of 130836 or 130839.
setup.verify_zh: 列入的位址之後被阻擋的查詢會記為 130818 或 130849，而不是 130836 或 130839。

setup.title: Allowlist names that Zenarmor files under Proxy or VPN
setup.title_zh: 把 Zenarmor 歸類為 Proxy 或 VPN 的名稱加入允許清單
setup.body: For a corporate VPN endpoint or a similar service in an evasion category: one name per line, exactly as it appears in the alert, then reload the ruleset. The list applies only to the evasion rules 130805 and 130806; malware and phishing alerts are never silenced by it.
setup.body_zh: 適用於公司 VPN 端點這類被歸到規避分類的服務：每個名稱一行，寫法與告警中完全相同，加入後重新載入規則集。此清單只作用於規避類規則 130805 與 130806，永遠不會讓惡意程式或釣魚告警靜音。
